cover.coreProposition: An externally visible Running state should be published only after the runtime holds evidence sufficient for the execution-readiness semantics its consumers rely on; scheduling, assignment and worker claim must remain distinguishable from readiness, and the demonstrated process-start boundary does not prove full health.
cover.visualMetaphor: A signal light remains amber while a separate engine core is only beginning to glow
cover.semanticObject: A restrained sequence from queued marker to active execution core with the final green state held behind a gate
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a strong left-to-right readiness threshold, deep navy field and one guarded green state
